# Plus Jakarta Sans

SAKU bundles Plus Jakarta Sans locally. Runtime font downloads are not allowed.

- Upstream: https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans
- Upstream revision reviewed: `18d1cd2f7ea10481919d2f05c1f7064b7307fc26`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`)
- Planned bundled weights: 400 Regular, 500 Medium, 600 SemiBold, 700 Bold

The font files must be committed to the application and referenced from `pubspec.yaml`; no CDN, Google Fonts runtime package, or network fetch may be required for typography.
